## Legend
- **Star**: ≥60% rate, ≥8 reviews — top performer
- **Solid**: 40-59% rate, ≥8 reviews — reliable
- **Weak**: 20-39% rate, ≥8 reviews — underperforming
- **Poor**: <20% rate, ≥8 reviews — struggling
- **Dying**: <20% rate, ≥10 reviews — heavy penalty (-5 score)
- **Dead**: <10% rate, ≥12 reviews — auto-excluded from selection
- **New**: <8 reviews — still being tested (gets exploration bonus)
